APPENDIX I – GRIEVANCE FILING AND TIMELINE CHART

| TYPE OF CASE | STEP 1 | STEP 2 | STEP 3 | STEP 4 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Letters of Reprimand and other grievances not listed below | Immediate excluded supervisor within 30 calendar days of the alleged violation* or receipt of the reprimand | University President or designee within 30 calendar days after the Step 1 response is due or received, whichever occurs first | USSE Director of Labor Relations within 30 calendar days after Step 2 response is received | Arbitration within 55 calendar days of receipt of Step 3 response by Union's Legal Department |
| Discipline other than letters of reprimand and dismissal | File at Step 2 | University President or designee within 30 calendar days of the effective date of the discipline | USSE Director of Labor Relations within 30 calendar days after Step 2 response is received | Arbitration within 55 calendar days of receipt of Step 3 response by Union's Legal Department |
| Group grievances involving multiple supervisors in one university | File at Step 2 | University President or designee within 30 calendar days of the alleged violation* | USSE Director of Labor Relations within 30 calendar days after Step 2 response is received | Arbitration within 55 calendar days of receipt of Step 3 response by Union's Legal Department |
| Layoff and Recall | File at Step 2 | University President or designee within 30 calendar days of the alleged violation * | USSE Director of Labor Relations within 30 calendar days after Step 2 response is received | Arbitration within 55 calendar days of receipt of Step 3 response by Union's Legal Department |
| Family Medical Leave Act (FMLA) and Oregon Family Leave Act (OFLA) | File at Step 2 | University President or designee within 30 calendar days of the alleged violation *; copy to OUS HR Division | FMLA - may be submitted to US DOL if unresolved OFLA – may be submitted to BOLI |  |
| Reclassification downward | File at Step 2 | University President or designee within 30 calendar days of receipt of notice of reclassification downward | USSE Director of Labor Relations within 30 calendar days after Step 2 response is received | Arbitration within 55 calendar days of receipt of Step 3 response by Union's Legal Department |
| Information Technology Competency Level | File at Step 2 | University President or designee within 30 calendar days of receipt of denial of employee's request to move to a higher competency level | USSE Director of Labor Relations within 30 calendar days after Step 2 response is received | Arbitration within 55 calendar days of receipt of Step 3 response by Union's Legal Department |
| Grievances regarding temporary employees | File at Step 2 | University President or designee within 30 calendar days of the alleged violation * | USSE Director of Labor Relations within 30 calendar days after Step 2 response is received | Arbitration within 55 calendar days of receipt of Step 3 response by Union's Legal Department |
| Discrimination grievances | File at Step 2 | University President or designee within 30 calendar days of the alleged violation* | EEOC/BOLI per applicable timelines |  |
| Dismissal | File at Step 3 | File at Step 3 | USSE Director of Labor Relations within 30 calendar days after the effective date of the dismissal | Arbitration within 20 calendar days of receipt of Step 3 response by Union's Legal Department |
| Group grievances involving multiple universities | File at Step 3 | File at Step 3 | USSE Director of Labor Relations within 30 calendar days of the alleged violation * | Arbitration within 55 calendar days of receipt of Step 3 response by Union's Legal Department |
| Denial of reclassification upward | File at Step 3 | File at Step 3 | USSE Director of Labor Relations within 30 calendar days of receipt of university/college denial of employee reclass request | Arbitration within 55 calendar days of receipt of Step 3 response by Union's Legal Department |

*The date the union or the grievant knew or by reasonable diligence should have known of the alleged grievance.

NOTE: If the deadline for filing or appealing a grievance falls on a Saturday or Sunday or university holiday, the deadline will be 5p.m. on the university next business day.
